name: nature-skills
description: Nature-style research skill pack: a `nature-skills` entry-point router that owns all data and empirical analysis end to end (8-step pipeline from data audit through results prose), plus academic search, citation management, data availability, scientific figures, paper-to-patent, paper-to-PPT, language polishing, reading/translation, reviewer-response drafting, peer review, and Nature-style scientific writing — plus an OpenClaw medical-skills module. Skills share a versioned knowledge layer under skills/_shared.

author.name: Yuan Yizhe (袁一哲) and the nature-skills community
